# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 7 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 16 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 32 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens; Size — 6 tokens; Opacity — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #22212c);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #22212c;
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #22212c | App background behind the top app bar and main column. |
| `--surface-container-lowest` | #17161d | Behind the player column in theater mode (Background's hue at 10%). |
| `--surface-container-low` | #272532 | The library drawer background (250° 15% 17%). |
| `--surface-container` | #2d2a39 | Stats panel and recording-details card background (250° 15% 19.5%). |
| `--surface-container-high` | #353243 | Search field, menus, hovered list rows, stat tiles (250° 15% 23%). |
| `--surface-container-highest` | #454158 | Thumbnail placeholders, slider tracks, avatar fallbacks. |
| `--surface-bright` | #4c4861 | Tooltip ground under `on-surface` text (8.2:1); dialogs. |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--outline, #7970a9);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #7970a9;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--outline` | #7970a9 | Outlined button, chip and text-field borders (≥3:1 on `surface` through `surface-container`). |
| `--outline-variant` | #393649 | Decorative hairlines: list dividers, card borders. Never the only cue for a control. |

### Use

```css

color: var(--dracula-background, #22212c);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */

```

| `--dracula-green` | #8aff80 | Dracula PRO Green. Source of `success` (connected, healthy). |
| `--dracula-orange` | #ffca80 | Dracula PRO Orange. Source of `warning` (partial captures, low disk). |
| `--dracula-red` | #ff9580 | Dracula PRO Red. Source of `rec` and `error`. |
| `--dracula-pink` | #ff80bf | Dracula PRO Pink. Not assigned to a role yet; the next categorical hue if a third stats series is added. |
| `--dracula-yellow` | #ffff80 | Dracula PRO Yellow. Source of `highlight` (search-match highlight). |
| `--primary` | #9580ff | Key actions and active state: filled buttons, seek-bar progress, active icon buttons, focus ring. As text, use only on `surface`, `surface-container-low` and `surface-container` (≥4.5:1); as a ring or icon it holds 3:1 up to `surface-container-highest`. |
| `--primary-container` | #3b3267 | Tonal purple emphasis: the cover's player slab, active quality option. Derived from Purple's hue (250° 35% 30%). |
| `--secondary` | #7970a9 | Low-emphasis marks: buffered range on the seek bar, inactive switch handle. |
| `--secondary-container` | #454158 | Selected library row, tonal buttons, active filter chip. |
| `--tertiary` | #80ffea | Network-statistics series (bandwidth, buffer sparklines) so network reads apart from video stats in `primary`. |
| `--tertiary-container` | #244c45 | Info banners and the 'Processing' status chip. Derived from Cyan's hue (170° 35% 22%). |
| `--success` | #8aff80 | Connected / healthy states: the dot on the connected Twitch account chip. Always beside a word. |
| `--warning` | #ffca80 | Warning icons and text on any surface: low disk space, retries. |
| `--warning-container` | #4f3c22 | The 'Partial' status chip. Derived from Orange's hue (35° 40% 22%). |
| `--error` | #ff9580 | Error text and icons on any surface (failed segment loads, auth failure), always with ⚠ or a word. |
| `--error-container` | #562d25 | Failure chips (Twitch session expired) and destructive confirmation banners. Derived from Red's hue (10° 40% 24%). |
| `--rec` | #ff9580 | Recording-in-progress signal: the REC dot, the live-edge tick on the seek bar and the REC chip fill. Shares Red with `error`; REC is always the pulsing dot or the REC label. |
| `--highlight` | #ffff80 | Search-match highlight behind matched characters in library titles. |
| `--twitch` | #9146ff | Fill of the Connect-with-Twitch button only — Twitch's brand purple, kept exact. Close in hue to `primary`; told apart by its white label and the Twitch wording. |
| `--twitch-hover` | #772ce8 | Hover/pressed fill of the Twitch button. |
| `--inverse-surface` | #f8f8f2 | Snackbar ground (e.g. 'Recording deleted · Undo'). |
| `--inverse-on-surface` | #22212c | Text on `inverse-surface`. |
| `--inverse-primary` | #4c33cc | Action text inside snackbars (7.4:1 on Foreground). |
| `--player-bg` | #000000 | The video element and letterbox area. Always pure black. |
| `--player-scrim` | rgba(0,0,0,0.6) | Flat scrim strip behind the player's control bar and title overlay. |
| `--scrim` | rgba(0,0,0,0.32) | Modal scrim behind the drawer on narrow layouts and behind dialogs. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 36px/44px "Manrope", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-small);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

### Font files

Fonts: one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

- **Design canvas:** bring a font that is kept by id, or was not copied, as for any other page, with its `@font-face` in the artboard after the `tokens.css` link; the linked `tokens.css` cannot load it.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap in chips; gap between stacked meta lines. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap between player control buttons; list row inner gap. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Library row padding; stat tile gap. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card and panel padding; app bar side padding. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gutter between the player column sections; main column padding. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Empty-state padding; section separation on wide layouts. |

## Opacity

Material state layers: an `on-*` color laid over the element at this opacity.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--state-hover: 0.08) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--state-hover), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--state-hover` | 0.08 | Hover state layer. |
| `--state-focus` | 0.10 | Keyboard focus state layer (plus the focus ring). |
| `--state-pressed` | 0.10 | Pressed state layer. |
| `--state-disabled` | 0.38 | Disabled content opacity. |
